title: Trimmis Profile 19 AI-assisted drawing screen

method.scope: Visual screen of labeled contacts and relative placement in the published P19 drawing.
method.decision_rule: Mark visually_consistent only when the labeled units and their contact or relative stratigraphic placement are visible without resolving ambiguous drawing semantics. Otherwise mark indeterminate.
limitations: This is not a qualified archaeological review.
The drawing does not machine-encode cuts, fills, boundaries, or label leaders.
Color and vertical placement alone are not treated as proof of chronology.
The screen cannot accept, reject, add, remove, or promote graph relations.
